top_issues: Primary total balance header blends with explanatory text callout, diluting immediate visual priority.
Color legend items for On-chain, Reserve, Secured, and Promised compete for focal attention.
fixes: Increase font contrast on secondary balance breakdowns.
Collapse explanatory bar guide into an accessible tooltip icon.

top_issues: Before/After account state cards create horizontal text density on right panel.
Secondary route breakdown details distract from primary transaction execution CTA.
fixes: Simplify account state delta cards to single unified preview bar.
Promote route summary higher in hierarchy with reduced copy.

top_issues: Action row with four buttons creates horizontal crowding at modal base.
Settlement proof hash truncated without immediate verification affordance.
fixes: Group receipt export actions into dropdown and isolate Done button.
Add explicit copy indicator icon adjacent to proof hash.

top_issues: QR code block visually detached from recipient account parameter inputs.
Entity ID panel placement causes fragmented scan path across sides.
fixes: Center QR code directly above incoming account selection field.
Stack address string beneath QR code with single copy trigger.

top_issues: Order book ladder creates excessive vertical height alongside simple swap form.
Spread and fee disclaimers appear low in contrast below entry fields.
fixes: Compress order book depth rows to top five bid/ask levels.
Elevate effective price and fee line directly below input box.

top_issues: Cross-network setup injects high cognitive load via collateral percentage toggles.
Conflicting primary buttons between Extend Credit and Swap confuse execution path.
fixes: Sequentially isolate credit limit extension into prerequisite modal step.
Standardize slider and percentage presets to single clear toggle group.

top_issues: Top action button bar has uneven visual weights across five options.
Credit line and collateral breakdown lacks immediate clear relation to current balance.
fixes: Reduce top button row to primary actions and place secondary actions in menu.
Align credit limit metrics directly beside current owed balance.

top_issues: Dual pane view leaves excessive vertical dead space in detail card on right.
Filter pill row competes visually with the page title and CSV export action.
fixes: Fill right side detail pane with complete audit and frame metadata.
Subordinate CSV export action below transaction filter row.

top_issues: Identical visual state to 07 with no distinct expanded inspection layer.
Underlying list item selection indicator lacks sufficient accent presence.
fixes: Highlight selected row with high-contrast active container background.
Expand frame signature proofs within the detail panel body.

top_issues: Dense vertical configuration list mixes low-level graphic units with critical security keys.
Pixel scale slider consumes primary visual priority over operational settings.
fixes: Group settings into distinct tabbed sections: Display, Network, and Security.
Demote bar scale configuration to an advanced sub-panel.

top_issues: Symmetric 3x2 grid of source and target boxes lacks clear directional progression.
Disclaimers in right explanation box require heavy reading for simple internal transfers.
fixes: Replace source/target card grid with segmented pickers connected by flow arrow.
Summarize transfer mechanics into bulleted cost and latency items.

top_issues: Hub cards and management navigation tiles lack a unified hierarchy.
Promised vs Owned breakdown card repeats home metrics without added detail.
fixes: Organize top navigation cards into clean standard grid with iconography.
Condense exposure summary card to highlight active settlement actions.

top_issues: Faucet controls given equal design weight to real on-chain wallet assets.
Complex credit sliders within faucet widget confuse testing with operations.
fixes: Move faucet and test utilities into secondary debug drawer.
Standardize asset balance table layout to emphasize reserve status.

top_issues: Hub pool statistics on right look empty and uninformative.
Basis point input creates usability hurdle for users expecting APR percentage.
fixes: Provide automatic APR percentage equivalent beside basis point field.
Add historical pool utilization figures to pool overview container.

top_issues: Dense paragraphs explain board and quorum concepts without visual diagramming.
Right panel 'Take control' states remain empty, reducing functional utility.
fixes: Render board threshold via signer avatar status nodes.
Replace explanatory text with structured signer management controls.

top_issues: Export and dispute triggers share secondary link formatting instead of clear actions.
Counterparty risk summary on right card is visually isolated from key proof status.
fixes: Convert Save Evidence Bundle to distinct primary action button.
Integrate counterparty dispute status into central ledger table.

top_issues: Dense data table layout compresses columns on typical desktop screen widths.
Order book and account lanes show competing visual weight without clear separation.
fixes: Increase column gutters in data table and use fixed numerical tabular figures.
Introduce distinct divider container between order book and account matrix.

top_issues: Command palette items lack shortcut badges for quick keyboard trigger mapping.
Subtext labels align unevenly across navigation destination items.
fixes: Add keyboard shortcut hints right-aligned to item labels.
Standardize palette entry height and row alignment.

overall.verdict: The interface demonstrates a cohesive, dark fintech aesthetic with mathematically consistent account visualizations. However, high cognitive overhead and dense protocol vocabulary hinder mainstream clarity and ease of use.
priority_fixes: Streamline complex bilateral credit and collateral configurations into simplified automated defaults.
Separate technical developer tooling and faucets from consumer-facing account workflows.
Improve responsive desktop breakpoints to prevent cramped tabular data on complex views.
Elevate critical security and dispute triggers into clear high-priority action elements.
Standardize transaction status feedback and proof exports across pay, receive, and swap flows.
